base_features.description: Comma-separated list of features to enable by default for all new ext2/3/4 filesystems.

block_size.description: Block size (in bytes); if 0, auto-detected. Use only if you need a non-default value.

default_mntopts.description: Default mount options (comma-separated) applied when the filesystem is mounted.

fs_types.description: List of filesystem type configurations. Each entry defines parameters for a named fs_type (e.g., ext2, ext3, ext4).

name.description: Name of the filesystem type (e.g., 'ext4', 'ext3'). Required.

features.description: Comma-separated list of features (e.g., 'has_journal,extent'). Use 'none' to disable all features.

block_size.description: Block size (in bytes). 0 means auto-select based on device or default.

inode_size.description: Size of each inode in bytes (typically 128, 256, or 512). 0 uses mke2fs default.

inode_ratio.description: Bytes per inode (e.g., 16384 = one inode per 16 KiB of disk). Lower = more inodes.

fragment_size.description: Fragment size (in bytes). Only relevant if fragment support is enabled.

reserve_ratio.description: Percentage of blocks reserved for the super-user (root). Prevents total disk exhaustion.

journal_size.description: Journal size in megabytes (only for journaling filesystems like ext3/ext4). 0 = auto.

journal_dev.description: Device to use for external journal (e.g., '/dev/sdb1'). Leave empty for internal journal.

root_dir.description: Path to a directory whose contents will populate the filesystem's root directory.
